topic: Dragon saving Luffy in Loguetown was not a coincidence, Dragon came to watch Luffy set sail
title: Dragon Didn't Save Luffy By Accident In Loguetown
description: Chapter 100 looks like a lucky storm. Chapter 432 and chapter 1101 say Monkey D. Dragon was there on purpose. Was Loguetown a father watching his son leave home?
comment: Is Dragon a loving father who watches from afar, or a leader who only cares about Luffy as a weapon? Pick one.

lines.text: Dragon didn't save Luffy in Loguetown by accident.

shot.fallback: cloaked man stopping a marine with wind

lines.text: Back in chapter 100, it looks like pure luck. A storm hits and Smoker gets stopped.

shot.fallback: pirate about to be struck down in a storm

lines.text: Then Garp says it plainly in chapter 432. That man is Luffy's father, Monkey D. Dragon.

shot.fallback: old marine telling a boy about his father

lines.text: Here is the part I think people forget.
Dragon is the most wanted man in the world, and he walked into a Marine town.

shot.fallback: wanted man walking into a marine town

lines.text: Why would he take that risk for one pirate rookie on his first day at sea?

shot.fallback: cloaked man watching a ship leave

lines.text: Chapter 1101 answers it. Dragon keeps tabs on his son whenever Luffy is back in the East Blue.

shot.fallback: cloaked man watching from a distance

lines.text: People say he only rescued Luffy because Smoker was about to catch a D.
But then why stay long enough to talk to Luffy at all?
Loguetown wasn't a lucky rescue. It was a father watching his son sail away.

shot.fallback: cloaked man and straw hat boy

lines.text: Dragon didn't save Luffy in Loguetown by accident...

self_check.hook: claim in line 1 that the rescue was deliberate
